dct_description_sm: This dataset records water quality of the Chedoke Creek watershed in Hamilton, Ontario. This ongoing monitoring program is designed to track water quality parameters over time. The dataset includes measures of chloride, nitrate and nitrite, phosphate, total phosphorus, E. coli, and total coliforms. Data collection is carried out every fall by the ENV-222 class and every summer by undergraduate research students.
dct_title_s: Chedoke Creek Water Quality Monitoring Data
